children: RNS Number : 6473V  Roundhouse AI Ltd  21 September 2026
Roundhouse (AQSE: ETHL), an artificial intelligence technology company, is pleased to announce that all resolutions proposed at the Annual General Meeting held earlier today were duly passed.
Additional information about the Company can be found on the website: roundhouseai.io

Roundhouse is a technology company specialising in AI infrastructure. The Company has developed and launched the first version of its public analytics dashboard, available on the Company's website, roundhouseai.io, serving as neutral infrastructure that observes and records AI agent to merchant transactions.
